description: People who meet joke around; each good encounter moves them a step closer, and after three they are friends who seek each other out, feel less lonely and calm each other down.

Loneliness.description: The need for company. Rises slowly, drops when joking with someone or spending time with a friend.

Attachment.description: Workaround flag: 0 until the person has made a first friend, then 1. Needs are the only per-person number a pack can write, so it stands in for 'has at least one friend edge'.

VisitFriend.description: Walk to the nearest friend and hang out for a while.

joked.description: They have shared a joke once: an acquaintance.

laughedWith.description: They have had a second good encounter: the jokes landed again.

friend.description: Three good encounters in: they are friends.

reactions.if: rel.laughedWith and not rel.friend and not rel.grudge and emotions.Anger < 0.6
rel.joked and not rel.laughedWith and not rel.grudge and emotions.Anger < 0.6
not rel.joked and not rel.grudge and emotions.Anger < 0.6
